components.name: Timing Console
components.description: A continuous four-part timing instrument with large condensed values and a shared summary.
components.html: Every 1 second
components.css: .ds-timing-console{overflow:hidden;border:1px solid var(--line,#3b3f45);border-radius:12px;background:var(--surface,#17191c);box-shadow:0 14px 32px rgba(0,0,0,.16);color:var(--text,#f5f5f1)}.ds-timing-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr))}.ds-timing-grid label{min-width:0;padding:14px 11px 12px;border-right:1px solid var(--line,#3b3f45)}.ds-timing-grid label:last-child{border-right:0}.ds-timing-grid label>span{display:block;margin-bottom:7px;overflow:hidden;color:var(--muted,#969aa1);font:650 10px/1.35 "Manrope Variable",Manrope,sans-serif;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap}.ds-timing-grid input{width:100%;height:55px;padding:0 4px;border:0;outline:0;background:transparent;color:inherit;font:650 clamp(34px,7vw,47px)/1 "Roboto Condensed Variable","Roboto Condensed",sans-serif;font-variation-settings:"wdth" 82;letter-spacing:-.045em;text-align:center}.ds-timing-grid label:focus-within{background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--signal,#b9e643) 5%,transparent);box-shadow:inset 0 -2px var(--signal,#b9e643)}.ds-timing-summary{padding:9px 14px 10px;border-top:1px solid var(--line,#3b3f45);color:var(--steel,#c4c7cd);font:620 13px/1.45 "Manrope Variable",Manrope,sans-serif;text-align:center}

components.name: Run Dock
components.description: The persistent chartreuse operational surface joining live run status to the primary start or stop action.
components.html: Ready when you areThe first click happens after one interval.
components.css: .ds-run-dock{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,.92fr) minmax(230px,1.08fr);min-height:82px;overflow:hidden;border-radius:12px;background:var(--signal,#b9e643);box-shadow:0 14px 36px rgba(0,0,0,.22);color:var(--signal-ink,#11130e);font-family:"Manrope Variable",Manrope,sans-serif}.ds-run-state{display:flex;min-width:0;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding:14px 16px}.ds-status-dot{width:16px;height:16px;flex:0 0 auto;border-radius:50%;background:currentColor}.ds-run-state strong,.ds-run-state small{display:block}.ds-run-state strong{font-size:12px;font-weight:800}.ds-run-state small{margin-top:4px;font-size:8px;font-weight:650;opacity:.72}.ds-primary-action{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:12px;margin:13px 0;padding:0 16px;border:0;border-left:1px solid rgba(17,19,14,.28);outline:0;background:transparent;color:inherit;cursor:pointer}.ds-primary-action:hover{background:rgba(255,255,255,.12)}.ds-primary-action:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--signal-ink,#11130e);outline-offset:-4px}.ds-primary-action:active{background:rgba(255,255,255,.18)}.ds-primary-action svg{width:28px;height:28px;fill:currentColor}.ds-primary-action span{font-size:20px;font-weight:820;letter-spacing:-.025em}.ds-primary-action kbd{padding:3px 6px;border:1px solid rgba(17,19,14,.28);border-radius:5px;font:650 10px/1 "Roboto Condensed Variable",sans-serif}

narrative.overview:
Clickity feels like a small, purpose-built instrument brought forward only when a gaming session needs it. Matte carbon surrounds graphite controls, while warm white language and crisp steel annotations keep the interface readable without turning it into a dense desktop form.

The system puts timing first and treats chartreuse as an operational signal rather than decoration. Broad rails, condensed numerals, and a persistent run dock create a quick top-to-bottom path: set the cadence, choose behavior, confirm the target, and act. The result is modern and technical without borrowing the neon, glass, or dashboard conventions common to gaming utilities.
keyCharacteristics: Matte, near-black tonal layering with restrained ambient depth.
One high-contrast chartreuse signal for selection, focus, capture, and run state.
Friendly Manrope interface language paired with compact Roboto Condensed instrument numerals.
Continuous timing fields, broad segmented rails, and a persistent action dock.
Compact, direct copy that keeps operating state visible.

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Chartreuse communicates an active or actionable state; keep it rare enough that selection and run state remain instantly legible.

rules.name: The Matte Spectrum Rule
rules.body: Build hierarchy from carbon and graphite layers, never from decorative gradients, glass, or saturated gamer lighting.

rules.name: The Instrument Pairing Rule
rules.body: Use Manrope for language and Roboto Condensed for values, coordinates, counts, and shortcuts; do not use the condensed face as a decorative display font.

rules.name: The Continuous Rail Rule
rules.body: Keep each task on one broad horizontal rail at desktop widths; use internal segmentation instead of scattering settings into unrelated cards.

rules.name: The Tonal Lift Rule
rules.body: Establish hierarchy with surface tone and one-pixel borders first; shadows remain soft, black, and subordinate.

rules.name: The Soft Containment Rule
rules.body: Round containers enough to separate them from the carbon canvas, but preserve straight internal divisions so controls still read as instruments.

dos: Do reserve chartreuse for selections, focus, capture, and the primary operational dock.
Do keep timing and other numeric values in the condensed instrument face.
Do use tonal graphite layers and one-pixel borders before adding ambient shadow.
Do keep state copy visible beside the primary start/stop action.
Do preserve the stacked responsive behavior and reduced-motion fallback.
donts: Don't imitate legacy autoclicker form stacks; settings belong in a short sequence of continuous rails.
Don't introduce neon gradients, glass panels, glows, or ornamental gamer-dashboard chrome.
Don't turn every surface into a floating card or every control into a pill.
Don't use chartreuse as decorative fill when it does not communicate state or action.
Don't separate timing values into unrelated boxed inputs; the continuous timing console is the signature component.
